notes.title: IIslands of War Released
notes.content:
IIslands of War has finally left Early Access! Usually, these announcements will have loads of excitement and updates and news about the future of the game moving forward with cool updates. Sadly, this is not one of those games.

[h2]Some History[/h2]
IIslands of War started as a fun project that I worked on as a university student. I seriously enjoyed my time developing this random idea about building floating islands in the sky and then blowing up other floating islands in the sky.

That was over 5 and a half years ago, and the game has been in Steam Early Access for almost exactly 4 years. 

[h2]The Rewrite[/h2]
However as I scoped more and more of the game, scope creep kicked in and I eventually decided that to move forward, I would need to rewrite basically the entire game to accommodate these new features. Check out some of the cool stuff I was working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/06431827a28e6375b13c6a3040ee24760a0afe69.jpg[/img]
[i]Yeah thats right, I made an infinite grid so you could build islands of any size.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/868bd22aa4e2c92c98b8f85b1df49200b301130c.jpg[/img]
[i]I wanted to have modules work more like a Tetris-like puzzle to try and optimize for.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/b8349dc00540950c7fdbaa2e63381a9a88a101a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/bf1f5bf1f250f33d1307e543bd05305cab53482b.jpg[/img]
[i]Massive spikes and buildings are always cool!![/i]

I also had plans for a story that would take you to different time lines and characters and pilots you could collect to give your island special abilities along the way and lore to go along with the strange world I was building! And monsters like giant floating whales and sky krakens and laser sharks!! And then a new map system with new ways of navigating the world with pirates that might raid you as you fast travelled and then you would have these really awesome high speed combat chases and stuff. And some out of game progression like a tech tree to unlock cooler weapons and items.

Boy did I have plans on plans...

[h2]Why did development stop?[/h2]
You see, I was a pretty meh programmer back then and so the code was essentially a giant pile of spaghetti. With my final year university project in 2022 and now having a full time job in 2024, continuing development of this massive project has been burdensome and hasn't brought me any joy. So development has stopped, permanently.

[h2]The Future[/h2]
As a result, IIslands of War is being taken out of Early Access, with no plans for any future development.  I'm really sad about this, because I loved IIoW and poured so much into it, as the wonderful community that grew around the game. To everyone who has supported the game, thank you so much. I truly would have never gotten to this stage without you. While my time with IIoW may be over, I hope that my passion for making games never dies. 

IIoW has had a great run. Thanks for playing,
jwiggs

notes.title: April Fools 2021 Event Suggestions!
notes.content:
Starting last year, we the April Fools Event around this time of the year is a wacky and strange event where interdimensional forces (you) invade the game by suggesting random things that I can quickly patch into the game! 

[h1]How can you suggest things?[/h1]
There are a few different ways you can suggest changes:

[b]1. Join the discord server![/b] There is a special channel for suggestions under #youtube-suggestions. I will primarily be going through this channel and adding in the suggestions from there.

[url=https://discord.gg/c3NQd47][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/7c10ea76eb3150d58ae36eadfe6b7030cc537689.png[/img][/url]

[b]2. Watch the YouTube livestream![/b] I will be livestreaming the crazy development of this event and if someone suggests something in the chat, I'll try and get to it!
https://youtu.be/yg5QTHHr2Es

[b]3. Comment on this event post with your suggestions![/b]
I will take a look through these before the livestream and might look at them at the end of development again, so the other two methods are probably more reliable to get me to see your suggestion.

There's no need to do all three of them, just one will be enough and I'll try my best to get through as many as possible! The key thing with the suggestions is that they have to be rather easy to implement. 

Here are some of my favorite changes from last year:
[list]
[*]Sky is bright pink
[*]Islands are constructed upside down
[*]Mortars fire downward and have upwards gravity
[*]A massive random explosion will spawn every 5-10 minutes
[*]Build area increased to 13x13. However, only visual changes were made to make it look like you have extra space. You still have a 12x12 build area.
[*]Hit sounds changed to rubber duck squeaky noises
[*]Excessive amounts screenshake
[/list]
…just to name a few.

Some of the changes from last year were so good that they became a permanent feature, like the warp gates spinning!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Enemies and Items Update
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]Enemies are the primary way you interact with the game and it has gotten rather stale. The purpose of this update was to overhaul the way enemies work and hopefully, create more fun gameplay as you shoot and blow them up.

In addition, this update has fixes for movement, RNG, and using every single item simultaneously.

[h1]New Items[/h1]Loads of new items that have explosions, slight gravity, cluster bombs, laser rays, flamethrowers, and more! Hold down right click when making a new game to launch yourself into sandbox mode and gain access to all the items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/edb9229a37d210367a2d7e2635151f250f4081c6.gif[/img]

[h1]Custom Enemies[/h1]Dark Order enemies no longer use the same items that you have access to and you cannot receive these items without creative mode, although there are plans to do so for another update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/b5aa7ea8097518f030c7820ffeb70edc9290fbd9.gif[/img]


[h1]Realm Bosses[/h1]With new items come special realm bosses that vary slightly each run. Realm bosses get a new type of weapon: colossal weapons! They are much larger than the normal weapons, and must be countered differently, forcing you to identify their weaknesses and swap up your playstyle!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/fc051a3b8654841efce11c411f9189ffb2b03699.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/fc051a3b8654841efce11c411f9189ffb2b03699.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Destruction Damage[/h1]
Enemies can hurt you, even after they have been destroyed! Watch out for their core explosions and their falling islands!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/060040344cc0af4d22256d44889e3a59272c5595.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/060040344cc0af4d22256d44889e3a59272c5595.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/3034721f9de259ab728b34a6000b51fa73ebc98f.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/3034721f9de259ab728b34a6000b51fa73ebc98f.gif[/img][/url]


[h1]Item Info Boxes[/h1]Colorful stat bars now give you a quick way to gauge the power of an item! For the number nerds, you can press shift to view the actual numbers as well.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/eec866b7a5be6ddde3ec0577c9618ffc348de3f9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/c129d9982719bbf6d7bd13fe01cbba380be7879c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/01ec56ee7ea68b1de9d2c774413ba7bdd32f557e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/0d2e9f1f3952ed670291fcc5e3a8b5d435bd0959.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/9d12ca69de1701de62bca049f74034fe4d28255b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/12fe8aba668e17a48301d0f897aa28f048e53a85.png[/img][/url]

The forge also has some cool animations for visualizing the changes in stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/60e24038a2d913b7be10be7f5e590603c6b4c761.gif[/img]

[h1]Island Stats[/h1]Like the item info boxes, but for your island! Quickly see an overview of the most important parts of your island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/26d765b65a78352b203bcc388b77f27ef1c88188.gif[/img]

[h1]Warp Mass[/h1]The game has struggled with balance for a few reasons, one of them being that you can place whatever you want on your island without restriction, leading to massive islands with extremely large amounts of firepower. While it's fun to blast your 30 cannons at the enemies, it gets boring really quick. 

Warp mass, measured in quatta, limits the number of items you can place on your island. Every block uses 3 quatta and weapons start at 6 quatta and increases its quatta use as you level them up. If your island exceeds the limit, you will not be able to build your island in survival mode.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list][*]Forging an item to increase the tier increases its stats significantly
[*]Forge percentages are now based on the current stats instead of the default stats
[*]Forge minimum and maximum stat limits removed
[*]Realm bosses always drop a movement item
[*]Enemies health and damage scale for the different realms to create a balanced and challenging experience
[*]Enemies can have modifiers to change their generation factors to have more weapons, armor, and shields, or blocks (among other things)
[*]Enemies take up a certain amount of space to limit the number of powerful enemy islands that can spawn in a single region at a time
[*]Enemies no longer lose their aggro on you, although moving too far away from them will cause them to deactivate (and do nothing)
[*]Any enemy that is aggro'd on you will prevent you from editing your island, which prevents you from editing and rebuilding your island in the middle of a hostile region
[*]Enemy movement and behavior has been radically improved simply simulate movement instead of actually using normal movement mechanics, allowing them to have greater control over their position
[*]Added cool item properties like charge effects, allowing items to modify themselves as seen in the chainguns modifying their rate of fire.
[*]New realm 9 boss!
[*]Projectiles moved to their own data structure, allowing them to have tertiary or quaternary projectiles
[*]Removed the laser trigger tech
[*]Your island gets rebuilt when revisiting the editor
[*]Major save file changes, both for players and enemies.
[*]Console command to go into freecam
[*]A bunch of other changes that are not as cool as these ones...
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]GameMaker has released a new version with a lot of lit features in the past few months. I am going to be porting the game over to this new version as well as taking the time to clean up, document, and optimize parts of the game so that it runs better for everyone. I'm expecting this to take a week, but given my awful estimates on time, this could drag out for a month.

After that, I would like to improve some aspects of the UI and interactions with it, specifically the map, shop and forge. School is starting up again in September, and I'm hoping to finish these smaller changes before starting another longer update during the next school semester to be ready by Christmas!

If you want to get access to test versions of these updates, join the Discord server! We will also be having a massive faction war in there soon, with at least a hundred islands battling it out in a simulated environment!

Let me know what the next major update should be in the comments: Persistence Update, Enemies Update II, Environment Update, Drones Update, or something else entirely! I try and listen to the community as much as possible!

notes.title: Enemies Rework - Phase 1
notes.content:
The biggest issue with the game is enemies. They all behave the same way and just end up being the same thing to the player: cannon fodder with no real strategy. This update is the first phase of a series of updates that will attempt to fix them.

[h1]Enemy Changes[/h1]
[h3]Behavior[/h3]Enemy classes now have special behavior patterns created for them, depending on their type of class. Some classes circle around you, others like to poke in and out, and some like the bomber class just want to move up and down. These behaviors are modularly built so that I can easily create cool patterns from simple commands.

[h3]Generation[/h3]While the island generation seemed alright for the most part, the classes themselves weren't incredibly balanced. In addition, sometimes enemies didn't spawn with weapons at all, so those issues were fixed as well.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
In an effort to make things more active and shooty, items have been adjusted. Some parts of your current items will not be affected but all new items will have these new changes.

[list][*]Energy weapons now deal extra damage to shields instead not dealing any damage at all. As later game items, it didn't make sense that they could be countered so hard by such an easy to acquire item like shields, and effectively rendering them completely useless. Now that energy weapons are extremely effective against shields, enemies can now just have energy weapons, though you won't see any because there aren't any energy enemy classes just yet.
[*]Quickshots, shotguns, lasers and autolasers have had their rotation speed increased to match their faster playstyle.
[*]Rockets rotation speed decreased, but has a significant amount more homing rotation.
[*]Gravity, acceleration, and deceleration speeds all significantly increased. This will hopefully make the island more responsive to your controls.
[*]Basic aerodynamic system implemented to promote not building rectangles. This is calculated based on your maximum dimensions to determine how rectangular the island is. Rectangular or vastly empty islands get a small movement speed penalty while building more triangular islands will give you an increase to movement speed.
[*]Enemies have fixed movement penalties to prevent them from flying all over the place and make them easier and more predictable to track down.
[*]Adjusted the weight of certain region types like cities to be more balanced out.
[*]Map invasion starts slightly farther back to give you an extra jump or two to hit those regions surrounding your spawn region.
[*]Final boss is harder.
[/list]

[h1]Technical Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Items will now use the sprite property
[*]Pressing F4 will execute the last console command, even if you do not have the console open.
[*]Added an editor_generate_random command to generate enemy classes
[*]Added and enemies command to view the different enemy classes
[/list]

notes.title: Map Tweaks
notes.content:
This small update has a few changes and tweaks to the map. The idea of moving towards the center of the realm wasn't quite working as well as I intended. Most of the time regions on the opposite side of the gate region would be left untouched and were rather useless.

So, I moved the gate region from the center of the map to opposite the starting region, hopefully allowing you to explore more and opening up more possibilities by increasing the distance between the where you start and where you need to go.

[h3]Realm[/h3][list][*]realm gate spawn on the opposite side of the map from your starting region
[*]starting region is always a passage
[*]increased speed of the invasion so you need to be at the gate within 9 jumps (from 11)
[*]passage regions no longer spawn normally
[*]tweaked the distribution of the different region types
[/list]
[h3]Region[/h3][list][*]hostile regions descreased in size
[*]outpost regions (!) have 3-4 enemies
[*]blockade regions (!!) have 5-6 enemies
[*]invaded regions (!!!) have 7-8 enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Overhauled News Hub
notes.content:
[h1]What is the News Hub[/h1]The news hub is a place where you can view the latest announcements like this one, or smaller patch notes. It is primarily so that I don't need to create a full Steam announcement for the small little changes I make, and also provides me with a way to give patch notes easily to those of you who are keen on testing newer unstable builds of the game (more on that later).

The hub has been built to support Steam's markdown as much as possible so that I can quite literally copy and paste the announcements right over. If you are viewing this in the game, then you have probably already noticed the little notification you get when there is a new news message.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/95e0e0bfc16dbb4915f4586b6fe692065bafc0d6.png[/img]

Major announcements and changes will still be posted here on the Steam News, however smaller micro patches will just show up in the news hub.

[h1]Why[/h1]Out of all the features I could have implemented first, why this one? There are a lot of issues with the game: bugs that need to be fixed and design changes that need to be made. Initially, I had planned to speed through as many of these changes as possible. However, I realized that it can get particularly confusing and tedious to stay up to date with the changes, especially when you see the game downloading a small patch and then not knowing why. So that's where the news hub comes in.

[h1]Features[/h1]
The news hub is pretty cool, and here is a really meta way to show off the features:
[list]
[*][url=https://trello.com/b/ilTFFkmw/iislands-of-war-skymap]Links[/url] - You can click on these to view them in the steam overlay or right click on them to open them in your browser.
[*]Lists
[*]Pretty much your basic markdown support with [b]bold[/b], [u]underlined[/u], [strike]strikethrough[/strike], and [spoiler]spoiler[/spoiler] text support.
[*]View this post in game to see the other features like image rendering (shown above) and image links (shown below).
[/list]
If you can't tell, I think this is pretty cool. A tad bit unnecessary, but awesome nonetheless.

[h1]Testing[/h1]For the few brave souls who want to venture into the unknown and get highly volatile, unstable test versions, you will need to join the [url=https://discord.gg/c3NQd47]Discord[/url] server. The discord server is still my primary method of having discussions and talking with the community about the game, and test versions will require direct communication to make things easier for me.

[url=https://discord.gg/c3NQd47][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/7c10ea76eb3150d58ae36eadfe6b7030cc537689.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Bug Reporting[/h1]There are quite a few bugs and places where the game crashes and it is really helpful for me if you report them. Details are absolutely essential for me to fix them, so in your reports let me know what it is you were doing. You last action that triggered the issue is useful, but the series of events leading up to the issue are equally important. 

The easiest way for me to access them, is to join the [url=https://discord.gg/c3NQd47]Discord[/url] server. This allows me to go back and forth with you quickly to obtain all the necessary details so that I can figure out what is going wrong. Unless I am sleeping, I am pretty much always online.

The less easy way is to report an issue is to post it on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1162470/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]. I try to check in here twice a day and respond to your messages as much as possible.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]Like I mentioned earlier, the next few days will be spent chugging away at fixing bugs and crashes as well as making simple changes to the game play such as map tweaks, and quality of life improvements.

I do have a rather large content packed update that has been in the works for quite some time now. I estimate it will be finished by the first week of April (though if my previous estimates are anything to go on, my estimates are pretty terrible).

That's all for this announcement! Stay tuned for those quick patches coming very shortly with fixes and actual changes (not just a boring news hub).

notes.title: Hello Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings[/h1]Hello to everyone reading this post, and allow me to introduce myself. I am jwiggs, and am the sole developer of IIslands of War. I am currently a university student studying computer science, but have been making games ever since I was a kid. Making games has been a journey for me, and this one is no exception. In this post I will be talking about where the game has come from, where the game currently is, and what is in store for IIslands of War in the coming updates.

[h1]The Past[/h1]In 2016, I participated in a small game jam with the entry [i]Islands of War[/i]. Inspired by games like [i]Minecraft[/i] and [i]FTL[/i], it was the start of what was to come. The game was simple, but slowly died as I lost interest in it.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/3d2e741cf69be92f72a8f468fed06548e6fc2a42.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/7191bb02dfe103674507e5ff854e91917cb55fe8.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/48abb71166d7677f3ffb98d1c6ffc041e17b2c4c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/d1408cdae70d03687b5cbb19a0a94de40f139af0.png[/img][/url]
[i]screenshots from the first game[/i]

Fast forward 2 years later, to the summer of 2018. Once again, I entered a game jam and decided to go for round 2 with my initial idea and IIslands of War was born (get it, the two I's are like roman numerals for the second game? never mind). While everything was quiet for the first week, a huge roar of interest sparked my attention. "Maybe there is something here after all", I thought to myself.

Since then, I poured all my free time into developing this game and handing out free updates on a smaller platform. When my semester ended in May 2019, I decided to give full time game development a shot. My leave of absence from university was approved, leaving me until September 2020 to pursue a dream in game development.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/c9b6e3798bc04943f9b6af0eb48c886a00d595aa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/f249691d6d5616c6b57e6e36db6b3d69b8de59b5.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/6962731e45a2a95f34f7c77f294bba3c88588649.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/726e7895b5bf6b2cb599856206944c019601c3be.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/c48873fd1fa0240720c3f54c06511adc39bcf92d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/dda6c0cb5cea19748afa6ccd4b096dd9a44df9ba.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/5491a013e451c6506510644d419ab95f18883e93.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/cf51a5812123bb229192f58172a0e12f540c9383.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/76211334c8d95181594ec9acb8686130e2a39c3b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/76211334c8d95181594ec9acb8686130e2a39c3b.gif[/img][/url]
[i]screenshots from this game's development[/i]

Looking back at the past one and a half years of development, the game has certainly come a long way. From one dimensional movement to two dimensions, dynamic items that can change and level up, enemy generation and behavior, I am proud of how far the game has come.

[h1]The Present[/h1]That bring us to today, with the game finally being shared with a really big audience. I am really excited for this new phase of development, but am just as nervous. I feel like a rookie stepping onto a court with all the big shots, and it is absolutely terrifying.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/dc0e2ece1c2c135480e3dd1e7f8ac0aef1d74c67.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/dc0e2ece1c2c135480e3dd1e7f8ac0aef1d74c67.gif[/img][/url] 

That being said, I am undoubtedly sure that the community that has kept me motivated and cheered me on will only grow from here, and I have done my best to bring as much of the community over to Steam during this transition.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/a326f51e2e62437869e969fc5ce898715d348109.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/a326f51e2e62437869e969fc5ce898715d348109.gif[/img][/url]

Speaking of the community, I will be primarily using the [url=https://discord.gg/c3NQd47]Discord[/url] server to connect with the community. I am incredibly passionate about opening the floor up for suggestions or feedback at any time! Some of the items or features that you see in the game are only there because of the community. 

[url=https://discord.gg/c3NQd47][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/7c10ea76eb3150d58ae36eadfe6b7030cc537689.png[/img][/url]

There are also factions within the server that you can join and compete in challenges against. These factions are earning items in challenges and eventually will go to war on a massive simulated live stream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/6015f65965a79dbe8ceb41b475f307271eaa7d04.jpg[/img]
[i]These faction names and mottos were suggested and voted upon by the community.[/i]

[h1]The Future[/h1]Out of everything here, I am most excited about what is to come. I have got around 6 months till school starts back up and development slows down, but til' then, its full speed ahead. I have a very open approach to the development of this game, which means I try to keep you informed as much as possible as well as try to hear what your thoughts are.

I keep the [url=https://trello.com/b/ilTFFkmw/iislands-of-war-skymap]Trello[/url] board updated most of the time, but here is a quick overview of some of the things I want to add to the game (in no particular order). 

[h3]More Items[/h3]I am currently working on this update to add more content into the game. With it will come a small rework of enemy generation to compliment the items added into the game.

[h3]Better Enemies[/h3]Enemy behaviors are incredibly important, and there's a fine line that enemies need to walk on between being smart, and being dumb.

[h3]Weather[/h3]Fog, day and night, wind, rain, thunderstoms, and all the like to spice up the game.

[h3]Environments[/h3]Going hand in hand with the weather, is making the environment more interesting with different themes and backgrounds for each region.

[h3]Drones[/h3]Cute little deadly drones that can be forged together from various parts like your existing weapons and tech.

[h3]Enforcers[/h3]Stop shooting the friendly islands. They don't drop anything yet, but when they do, you bet enforcers will come to their aid. 

[h3]Progression Systems[/h3]I have ideas for systems both inside and outside each "run". Within each run you could progress to get larger build areas or be allowed a larger weapon capacity. Outside each run I might implement a system to systematically unlock new items.

[h3]Blueprints[/h3]Pretty much crafting recipes. A + B = C.

[h3]Mod Support[/h3]I'm a really big fan of user generated content, and I have been slowly making sure the internal structures of the game can adapt to support custom items and enemies. I intend to use the Steam Workshop to allow you to easily share your mods with everyone else.

[h3]Achievements[/h3]While the game won't be launching with any achievements, that will be remedied within the next few updates.

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1]To everyone in the community who have been so supportive of the game, thank you. It has been an amazing journey thus far developing this game along with you all. I am excited to be launching forward into this new phase of development, with so much to do, and seemingly so little time. 

To all of you who are just joining us, welcome! We're glad you have joined our small and increasing number. I hope you'll come along and enjoy this wild ride as much as I have.
